verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page explicitly lists 'A/B test subject lines & content' as a feature, confirming the capability exists, but there is no documentation describing how winners are determined from engagement data, timing windows, or content-variant testing (as opposed to just subject lines). Missing for 10: detailed docs on the winner-selection algorithm/metric, evidence of content-variant (not just subject line) testing, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of the feature working as described.
